The Tutaekuri-Waimate Stream Restoration and Protection Project aims to restore and protect the Waimate Stream along Chesterhope Station, which was severely impacted by Cyclone Gabrielle. The project involves fencing off stream edges and planting native vegetation to exclude livestock, stabilize banks, improve water quality, and enhance biodiversity. Initial work has already seen 700 meters fenced and planted in July 2025. This is a collaboration between the Joan Fernie Charitable Trust (JFCT) and Fair Trade, with plans to extend restoration along the entire stream boundary. Completion will involve continued planting, fencing, and monitoring with support from trustees and local volunteers.
